textwithimage.text:
Embedded Cortex®-A55 module based on i.MX 93xx with Machine Learning Accelerator

The TQMa93xxLA based on the i.MX 93xx supports with many features and an integrated NPU (Neural Processor Unit) with up to 0.5 TOPS in the implementation of applications where artificial intelligence, machine learning/vision is to be applied. A GPU and several graphic interfaces are available for graphically demanding applications. For real-time and security the CPU is supported by a Cortex M33 controller.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm® Cortex® A55 based on i.MX 93xx
  • Machine Learning Accelerator 0.5 TOPS
  • Integrated Cortex®-M33
  • High-speed communication via 2x Gbit Ethernet (1x TSN), 2x USB 2.0 interface
  • Low power consumption (typ. 2W)
  • Integrated security functions

STKa93xxLA-AA

STKa93xxLA (Eval Kit) with TQMa93x2LA, Dual Cortex A55/1,7 GHz, 1 GB LPDDR4, 8 GB eMMC Flash, 64 kB EEPROM, RTC, 2x USB 2.0 HOST, 1x USB Type C, 2x ETH 10/100/1000, 2x CAN FD, 1x RS485, 1x LVDS, 1x MIPI CSI, 1x DP, WLAN, Temperature sensor, GPIOs (4x 24V_IN, 4x 24V_OUT, 8x AI_IN (programmable Analog Frontend), Reset-Button, SD Card interface, WiFi, Mobile Network, Power Supply, 8 GB Micro SD card, Cables, Connectors
Starterkit STKa93xxLA set

The core of the STKa9xxLA set is the TQMa93xxLA module with a Dual Cortex®-A55 CPU. The components contained in the starter kit constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. Development of graphic interfaces can be started immediately using the prepared combination of closed display unit and starter kit that are matched to each other. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of the starter kit in your own designs.
Other configurations on request
